name: PokeWallet API
description: Pokemon TCG cards database with real-time pricing from TCGPlayer and CardMarket

health.description: Health check endpoint with service status

search.description: Search cards with TCG and CardMarket pricing (supports pagination)

cardDetail.description: Get card details with unified pricing. Supports encrypted IDs (pk_xxx) or plain card numbers with ?set_code parameter

sets.description: List all Pokemon sets with card counts

setDetails.description: Get cards for a specific set (paginated)

images.description: Card images from R2 bucket via API proxy (PROTECTED). Requires X-API-Key header. Example: /images/pk_xxx?size=high or /images/pk_xxx?size=low
